name: Frag Bomb use
summary: Ogryn Frag Bomb: Dexterity save, full/half damage and manual prone outcome.
descriptionMarkdown: Resolve each target in the 20 ft radius separately: failure takes full 4d6 piercing and is knocked prone; success takes half damage and is not knocked prone. Exact half damage does not choose an integer rounding rule.
